page.summary: Simplified commerce cart with page title/progress, two-column cart-items/order-summary layout, specialist reassurance CTA and global footer.

global_layout.primary_alignment: Centered wide container; title, cart panel and specialist banner share the same left edge.

components.description: Wide consumer header with logo, nav, utility icons/cart count and fitment CTA.
Gold YOUR ORDER eyebrow above large navy SHOPPING CART title.
Three-step horizontal progress with Cart active, Checkout and Confirmation inactive.

sections.name: Cart items and order summary

components.description: Large bordered left panel containing two cart line items, each with wheel render, model/specs, green fitment confirmation, price, quantity control and edit/remove actions.
Right light-gray order summary card with subtotal/shipping/taxes, large estimated total, Affirm line, gold checkout CTA, outlined continue shopping and three trust items.

relationships: Order summary begins level with top of cart-item panel.
Primary checkout CTA spans most of summary width.

components.description: Wide dark wheel-image banner with centered specialist copy and outlined Get in Touch button.
Wide consumer footer with five content regions and legal row.

shared_components.name: Primary site header
shared_components.reason: Repeated on Home, Category, Product and Cart with dark navy bar, Calder logo, nav, utility icons and outlined gold fitment CTA.

shared_components.name: Primary site footer
shared_components.reason: Repeated on consumer-facing pages with dark navy multi-column footer, Calder mark, social icons and legal row.

shared_components.name: Find Your Fit CTA
shared_components.reason: Repeated high-priority gold/outlined action in consumer header and fitment workflows.

shared_components.name: Gold uppercase eyebrow
shared_components.reason: Repeated section-label pattern across marketing, collection, cart and portal compositions.

shared_components.name: Navy / gold button system
shared_components.reason: Repeated rectangular CTAs with low radius, uppercase tracked labels and arrow affordances.

shared_components.name: Commerce progress indicator
shared_components.reason: Cart and Checkout both use staged progress, with different step counts/presentation.

shared_components.name: Order summary card
shared_components.reason: Cart and Checkout both present a right-side monetary summary and primary order action.

unique_components.name: Editable cart line-item list
unique_components.reason: Cart-specific product review and quantity/edit/remove controls.

responsive_assumptions.assumption: Order summary likely moves below cart items on narrow screens.
Progress labels may compress while preserving active-step state.

implementation_notes: Keep the page materially simpler than marketing pages; whitespace is part of the design.
Maintain green fitment confirmation close to each line item's vehicle metadata.
Do not visually compete with the gold Proceed to Checkout CTA.

uncertainties.unknown: Static screenshot cannot establish whether order summary is sticky during scroll.
uncertainties.resolution: Check existing cart behavior; preserve if functional unless it conflicts visually.
